Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 assays against human single-protein target CHEMBL1075126 (Pyruvate kinase PKLR). Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1075126, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Order by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id.
